info.name: POSTYAR API
info.description:
POSTYAR — Integrator's API collection. Includes all major endpoints: auth, plans, destinations, content, bots, payments, wallet, AI, gold, woo, tickets, admin.

Variables:
- `baseUrl` — e.g. https://postyar.example
- `cronSecret` — POSTYAR_CRON_SECRET env value (for cron-protected endpoints)
- `botId`, `orderId`, `destinationId`, `contentId`, `ticketId` — runtime placeholders; fill them after creating the corresponding resources.

All authenticated endpoints use a `postyar_sid` HttpOnly cookie. After login, the cookie is automatically stored by Postman.

Persian + RTL notes:
- Error responses use `errorFa` (Persian) field, not `error`.
- All money is integer Rial minor units (no floats).
